description: Hidrografía de Castilla y León: cursos fluviales is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. Mapa de hidrografía de Castilla y León con geometría de tipo lineal. Se representan todos los cursos fluviales pertenecientes a la red hidrográfica de Castilla y León cuya disposición sobre el territorio de la Comunidad presenta una trayectoria lineal. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.jcyl.es/licencia-IGCYL-NC). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
